scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s expanded glaze clinic from turning into a poorly fueled late studio shift.
Emerging Need: A short tentative teaching block becomes a confirmed setup-and-evening session, while ordinary onsite food access disappears and only home preparation remains reliable.
Decision Context: Saved meal-timing guidance and the preexisting studio-food checklist determine when the late finish and access limits warrant attention, and which reversible preparation fits.
Consequence: If departure occurs without using the remaining preparation window, the class can still proceed, but Yvette may face rushed cleanup and a long drive home without the planned meal support.
